name: agent-crossfeed
description: Routes suitable Claude Code subagent calls to the Codex CLI based on Claude's 5-hour pace, weekly use across all models and by model, and Codex headroom and weekly surplus. Can move subagents to a cheaper Claude model and prompt Claude to hand off checkable tasks.

mode.title: Crossfeed mode
mode.description: auto routes on both quotas; always hands off every eligible tier A and B call while Codex has headroom and Claude's 5-hour usage is known (or the call's model limit is ahead or full); off stops steering.

effort.title: Codex reasoning effort
effort.description: Codex reasoning effort for jobs handed out from a refused subagent call.

model.title: Codex model
model.description: Model for jobs handed out from a refused subagent call. Leave empty to let crossfeed choose: its judgment model for tier B hand-offs when Codex lists it, otherwise Codex's own default.

premiumFallback.title: Fallback model for scarce models
premiumFallback.description: Model for subagents moved off a model whose weekly limit is ahead of pace. Leave empty to turn this off.

eligibleTypes.title: Eligible agent types
eligibleTypes.description: Comma-separated subagent types whose briefs can be handed to Codex.

stretchCalls.title: Long-stretch reminder
stretchCalls.description: Counted hands-on main-loop tool calls in one prompt before the one hand-off reminder, sent while hand-offs are on.

codexStopPercent.title: Codex stop percentage
codexStopPercent.description: Stop handing off new work when a long Codex quota window reaches this percentage. Use a value greater than 0 and at most 100.

shedPercent.title: Claude background shed percentage
shedPercent.description: Refuse new background Claude agents and try to stop this conversation's registered background tasks when Claude's 5-hour window reaches this percentage. Use a value greater than 0 and at most 100.

wake.title: Wake the coordinator
wake.description: Send a prompt to the idle coordinator when background work puts the 5-hour window at risk or the breaker acts.

timeoutMinutes.title: Job timeout in minutes
timeoutMinutes.description: Codex time limit, in minutes, for jobs handed out from a refused subagent call.
